tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Порівняння англійською. Короткі слова: + -er + than: fast → faster than, big → bigger than (подвоюємо g), friendly → friendlier. Довгі слова: more + слово: more famous, more important. Неправильні: good → better, bad → worse. Приклади: «I'm faster than you!» · «It's bigger than our town!» · «Friends are more important than the cup.»
tasks.q_pl: Stopień wyższy po angielsku. Krótkie słowa: + -er + than: fast → faster than, big → bigger than (podwajamy g), friendly → friendlier. Długie słowa: more + słowo: more famous, more important. Nieregularne: good → better, bad → worse. Przykłady: „I'm faster than you!” · „It's bigger than our town!” · „Friends are more important than the cup.”
tasks.q_en: Comparatives. Short words: + -er + than: fast → faster than, big → bigger than (double the g), friendly → friendlier. Long words: more + word: more famous, more important. Irregular: good → better, bad → worse. Examples: "I'm faster than you!" · "It's bigger than our town!" · "Friends are more important than the cup."
